name: CrowdHuman
description: A pedestrian detection dataset focused on crowded scenes, with full, visible, head, and body bounding boxes across about 15k images and 470k boxes. The dataset is subject to SenseTime release terms; this record does not vendor data.
citation: Shao, S., Zhao, Z., Li, B., Xiao, T., Yu, G., Zhang, X., & Sun, J. (2018). CrowdHuman: A Benchmark for Detecting Human in a Crowd. arXiv:1805.00123.

license.identifier: SenseTime release terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
